title: Gulf Construction | Parsons-Led JV Secures Riyadh Metro Red Line Extension Contract
summary: Parsons Corporation, a leading infrastructure engineering firm, has announced that its joint venture, Riyadh Metro Transit Consultants (RMTC), in partnership with Systra and Egis, has secured the contract to provide project and construction management services for the Riyadh Metro Red Line Extension. The post Gulf Construction | Parsons-Led JV Secures Riyadh Metro Red Line Extension Contract appeared first on Parsons Corporation .
